title: AS2 compiler: comma operator (sequence expression) not supported
description: The AS2 compiler does not handle comma expressions. In Flash AS2, for(i=0,j=0;;) uses a SequenceExpr/CommaExpr. The parser may produce a comma-separated list as part of ExpressionStatement. Fix: in compiler.ts, if the parser has a SequenceExpr node (or ExprStmt with comma), compile each sub-expression left-to-right and pop intermediate results (ActionPop after each except the last). Check parser.ts first to see what AST node comma expressions produce.
